CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.UpsertProduct
    @Sku NVARCHAR(50),@Name NVARCHAR(200),@Price DECIMAL(10,2),@CategoryId INT
AS BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    MERGE dbo.Products AS tgt
    USING (SELECT @Sku AS Sku,@Name AS Name,@Price AS Price,@CategoryId AS CategoryId) AS src
    ON tgt.Sku=src.Sku
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET tgt.Name=src.Name,tgt.Price=src.Price,
                   tgt.CategoryId=src.CategoryId,tgt.UpdatedAt=SYSUTCDATETIME()
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT(Sku,Name,Price,CategoryId,CreatedAt)
        VALUES(src.Sku,src.Name,src.Price,src.CategoryId,SYSUTCDATETIME());
END;
